title: Closed direct image is exact on coefficient systems
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, the coefficient-system base data of [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], and a closed immersion f:X→Y locally of finite presentation. For any Geometry realizing its ordinary system direct image with the specified levelwise comparison, its push functor preserves finite limits and finite colimits.

source.place: Lemma 6.1.17; finite exact direct image, transported through the prescribed finite-level comparisons.

proof.text: System evaluation is jointly faithful: equality on all levels implies equality on each (level, chart) component of the underlying module presheaf. Evaluation is exact by the coefficient-system definitions.

A closed immersion is finite. At each finite coefficient ring, use uniqueness of right adjoints and openSquarePullbackModel to identify constant-ring pushforward with the conjugate of fixed-scalar lowerStar by sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence. The finite direct-image theorem supplies finite-colimit preservation; the constant-ring adjunction supplies finite-limit preservation.

Use the source-library exactFunctor_of_iso criterion for a jointly conservative exact family, with ordinaryPushEvaluation. Each level composite is exact, so system push preserves finite limits and colimits.
